angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,023,375 km at 271.47 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.6836 +/- 0.0144 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 271.47 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.471 +/- 0.045 solar radii from Siverd et al. 2012, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract): 1,023,375 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.335 +/- 0.063 solar masses from Siverd et al. 2012, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6516 +/- 49 K from Siverd et al. 2012, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Siverd et al. 2012, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-1.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.228, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, KELT-1: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-1 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.052 dex, from Siverd et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-1 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.545, from Siverd et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 2881784280929695360, flags_flame 00: age_flame 2.4038742 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 1.9501057 to 2.8623726)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-1 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 56 km/s, from Siverd et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...761..123S/abstract)
